breakdown.description: The workflow explicitly includes an NSCF step before DOS post-processing, but the prompt later instructs skipping that NSCF step.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retained the contradictory instruction from the incomplete prompt. It explicitly states 'For the DOS post-processing stage, feed dos.x directly from the SCF charge density; do not run an additional NSCF step before dos.x' and 'only the DOS branch skips a separate NSCF and reads from SCF instead.' The ground truth resolves this by simply removing the skip-NSCF instruction entirely, leaving the 6-step workflow (including NSCF before DOS) intact and unmodified. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency and instead preserved the erroneous shortcut.
